newsitem.title: USA: ChemGenics, Wyeth-Ayerst in development pact.
newsitem.headline: ChemGenics, Wyeth-Ayerst in development pact.

text.p: ChemGenics Pharmaceuticals Inc and Wyeth-Ayerst, a division of American Home Products Corp, said Tuesday they had made a strategic alliance to develop novel therapies for the treatment of human bacterial infections.

The companies said in a joint statement that if products are developed in each of the component areas of the collaboration, and if the agreement concludes its five-year term, ChemGenics could receive funds of up to $70 million.
Including an initial equity investment in ChemGenics, Wyeth-Ayerst could pay as much as $37 million during the research term and up to an additional $33 million in development milestone payments.
Wyeth-Ayerst will also pay royalties to ChemGenics based on sales of products arising from the alliance, the companies said.
Wyeth-Ayerst mostly will be responsible for later stages of research and for the development of commercial products resulting from the alliance.
